articles.title: Apache Tomcat Update Fixes WebSocket and HTTP/2 Flaws Affecting Server Security
articles.summary:
Apache Software Foundation has released Tomcat 11.0.26 to address 12 security vulnerabilities spanning WebSocket, HTTP/2, AJP, authentication, and TLS certificate validation. The flaws, disclosed September 23, 2026, include four rated Important, three Moderate, and five Low, giving administrators a broad but urgent patching task across internet-facing Java application servers.
